acceptance_criteria.description: Pure Kotlin domain defines RobotCommand (CLEAN, PAUSE, RESUME, DOCK) with canonical wire status mapping (Clean, Pause, GoHome).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-201: JUnit asserts exact literal wire tokens for all 4 commands matching SPEC-PROT-01 and SPEC-STATE-01.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotMode explicitly models DOCK, CLEAN, PAUSED, RETURNING_DOCK, CHARGING, DORMANT, IDLE, and FAULT.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-202: JUnit verifies all 8 RobotMode enum values and docked classification semantics.

acceptance_criteria.description: Package com.weback.robot.domain contains zero android.*, androidx.*, kotlinx.coroutines.*, kotlinx.serialization, or okhttp3.* imports.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-201: Static source scan test enforces pure Kotlin domain dependency boundary.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotStateMachine accepts authorized transitions for CLEAN, PAUSE, RESUME, and DOCK deterministically.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-203: Table-driven JUnit verifies all valid (sourceMode, command) pairs return Accepted with expected literal target mode.

acceptance_criteria.description: Guard evaluation enforces deterministic precedence FAULT_ACTIVE > LOW_BATTERY (CLEAN/RESUME) > INVALID_TRANSITION without mutating RobotState.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-204: Complete 8x4 mode-command matrix across battery (0, 14, 15, 100) and errorCode (0, 9001) verifies exact rejection precedence.

acceptance_criteria.description: CLEAN and RESUME are allowed at batteryPercentage == 15 when otherwise valid and rejected with LOW_BATTERY below 15 without mutating state.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-204: Boundary table JUnit at batteryPercentage 0, 14, 15, and 100 verifies exact LOW_BATTERY boundary behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Domain defines sealed CommandExecutionState (Idle, Pending, Acknowledged, Rejected) and CommandRejectionReason with unique monotonic commandId and MonotonicClock timestamps.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-205: JUnit verifies sealed hierarchy, immutability, unique commandId emission, and MonotonicClock timestamps.

acceptance_criteria.description: Valid commands emit Pending before ack while holding committed mode unchanged until confirmation; locally invalid commands emit Rejected without calling transport.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-205: StandardTestDispatcher virtual-time timeline verifies Pending before ackDelayMs, Acknowledged + updated mode after advanceTimeBy, and 0 transport sends on local invalid command.

acceptance_criteria.description: Transport rejection or unexpected exception transitions Pending cleanly to Rejected while keeping committed RobotState authoritative (no rollback).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-206: Fault- and exception-injected transport tests verify Pending -> Rejected (TRANSPORT_REJECTED / TRANSPORT_ERROR) with unchanged committed RobotState.

acceptance_criteria.description: Bounded timeout settles Pending to Rejected(TIMEOUT) without rolling back committed telemetry.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-217: Virtual-time withTimeout test verifies actual TIMEOUT settlement, telemetry preservation, and subsequent command acceptance.

acceptance_criteria.description: External CancellationException is never swallowed, cleans up owned Pending state to Idle, and leaves subsequent commands unblocked.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-218: Cancellation test verifies CancellationException propagates, Pending cleans up to Idle, and subsequent valid command succeeds.

acceptance_criteria.description: Completion identity checks verify Pending.commandId == commandId so stale completions cannot overwrite newer command lifecycles.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-219: Stale completion correlation test asserts late ack/reject for superseded commandId=1 does not alter active commandId=2.

acceptance_criteria.description: Duplicate command submission while same command is Pending is atomically blocked without dispatching a second RobotTransport call.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-207: Spy transport counter asserts exactly 1 sendCommand call on duplicate/concurrent dispatches during Pending.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conflicting command submission while Pending is blocked atomically without dispatching a second transport call and exposes non-destructive busyConflictNotice.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-208: Virtual-time conflict sequence asserts 0 extra transport sends, preserved Pending command, and non-null busyConflictNotice.

acceptance_criteria.description: After Pending settles to Acknowledged, Rejected, or cancellation cleanup, subsequent valid commands execute cleanly without stale lockup.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-218: Cancellation recovery and post-settlement sequence assert subsequent valid commands succeed cleanly.

acceptance_criteria.description: DismissCommandFeedback during Pending does not release the active Pending command lock.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-208: DismissCommandFeedback while Pending preserves Pending state, disabled controls, and active lock until transport settles.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotTransport exposes suspend fun sendCommand(RobotCommand): CommandResult and StateFlow<RobotState>.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-209: Contract tests verify serialized CommandResult delivery and monotonic StateFlow emissions.

acceptance_criteria.description: SimulatorRobotTransport injects DispatcherProvider, SimulatorConfig with documented defaults, and MonotonicClock driving RETURNING_DOCK -> CHARGING -> DOCK deterministically.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-210: StandardTestDispatcher runTest advances virtual clock cleanly through RETURNING_DOCK, CHARGING, and DOCK.

acceptance_criteria.description: All state mutations follow unified stateMutex without holding lock across delays; commit point revalidates guards against latest telemetry after ackDelayMs.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-220: Virtual-time command-vs-tick race verifies tick/fault during ackDelayMs executes cleanly and commit point revalidates against latest telemetry.

acceptance_criteria.description: Delayed simulator jobs check mode/stateGeneration, cancel obsolete jobs on state exit, and support deterministic failure injection.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-221: Obsolete docking/charging job cancellation and generation-check test prevents stale overwrites.

acceptance_criteria.description: SimulatorRobotTransport.close(), AppContainer.close(), and DashboardViewModel scope cleanup cancel background coroutines with zero leaked jobs.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-222: Lifecycle cleanup tests verify close() halts active drain/dock/charge jobs with zero subsequent mutations or leaks.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotState enforces batteryPercentage in 0..100; CLEAN drain auto-returns below 15%; CHARGING clamps at 100% and transitions to DOCK.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-211: Boundary and virtual-time tests verify IllegalArgumentException outside 0..100, non-negative drain, auto-docking, and clamp at 100.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotState.isDocked equals true if and only if mode is DOCK or CHARGING.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-212: Exhaustive enum test checks isDocked across all 8 RobotMode values.

acceptance_criteria.description: Control transitions preserve robot name and dustbin status, and errorCode != 0 consistently represents RobotMode.FAULT.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-212: Multi-step transition sequence asserts metadata preservation and FAULT consistency on errorCode != 0.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reaching 0% battery while undocked (initial or runtime) stops simulated movement and enters RobotMode.FAULT with synthetic errorCode 9001.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-211: Undocked 0% battery initialization and runtime depletion tests verify FAULT transition with synthetic errorCode 9001 while docked 0% remains docked.

acceptance_criteria.description: ControlAvailability.from derives canClean, canPause, canResume, canDock directly from RobotStateMachine, fault, and Pending state across all modes including RETURNING_DOCK.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-213: Independent truth table asserts exact ControlAvailability booleans across all 8 modes, battery boundaries, errorCode != 0, and Pending.

acceptance_criteria.description: DashboardViewModel exposes unidirectional onIntent(DashboardIntent) updating backward-compatible StateFlow<RobotUiState> via injected DispatcherProvider.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-213: MVI ViewModel contract tests verify deterministic StateFlow updates across all intent variants.

acceptance_criteria.description: DismissCommandFeedback resets settled feedback banner to Idle without mutating telemetry or halting simulation.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-214: JUnit verifies DismissCommandFeedback clears settled commandState/busyConflictNotice while preserving RobotState.

acceptance_criteria.description: DashboardScreen renders accessible string-resourced Material 3 Clean/Pause/Resume/Dock controls bound to ControlAvailability and visible command_status_banner.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-215: Robolectric Compose UI rule asserts enabled/disabled button semantics and status banner text across states including RETURNING_DOCK.

acceptance_criteria.description: DashboardScreen persistently renders OFFLINE simulator_badge, readable light/dark layouts, and simulator wording across all control transitions.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-215: Compose UI assertions verify simulator_badge remains displayed across light/dark themes and all modes/states.
